title: Proving Budan's Upper Bound in Lean
description: Proof scaffold for the Budan upper bound theorem: the number of roots of a polynomial p in (a,b] is at most V_p(a) - V_p(b), where V_p is the Budan-Fourier sign variation count.

meta.author: Budan de Boislaurent (1807), proof scaffold
meta.assumptions: 0 axioms, 1 sorry (inductive step of budan_upper_bound). Base case (degree 0) fully proved. Building blocks proved: constant_no_roots, linear_at_most_one_root, rolle_polynomial, root_of_sign_change.

overview.problemStatement: Prove the Budan upper bound: #roots(p, (a,b]) <= V_p(a) - V_p(b).
overview.text: Partial proof of Budan's upper bound via induction on polynomial degree. Infrastructure includes sign-change counting (budanCount, rootsInInterval), building blocks (Rolle, IVT, linear root bound), and degree-0 base case. The inductive step requires sign-change accounting relating V_p(x) to V_{p'}(x).
overview.proofStrategy: Strong induction on deg(p). Base: deg 0/1 trivial. Step: Rolle gives derivative roots between polynomial roots, IH on p' for sub-intervals.
